profile.headline: swe at ngrok
profile.summary:
I’m a Computer Science grad (BS, Colorado School of Mines, Dec 2022) who loves architecting and building AI workflows to solve real-world problems. Currently, I’m developing an AI tools for bet365. Previously, I built conversational AI agents for home service scheduling, integrating with CRMs using Golang and RAG architectures to automate tasks.

I’m passionate about crafting high-throughput, low-latency microservice architectures, deployed with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines optimized for AI workflows. Using Docker and Kubernetes, I ensure scalability, while my React.js/TypeScript skills power real-time data visualization frontends. I also build webservers and CLI tools in the AI space, leveraging AI coding tools to prototype and ship products crazy fast. My drive is using AI workflows to tackle business challenges, helping teams deliver awesome solutions with cutting-edge tech.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building high-performance microservices for real-time data systems. Developed microservices to process live streaming data from Kafka, store it in Valkey, and deliver real-time updates to frontend trading applications. Created a high-throughput algorithm to concurrently process Kafka data, ensuring synchronized event handling, fault-tolerant offset management, and idempotency using AI development tools. Designed an AI-powered code QA agent integrated into CI/CD pipelines, automating Go code reviews with human-like feedback in GitLab MRs via multi-agent workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Gitlab · Ci/cd

positions.title: Applied AI Engineer
positions.description: Built conversational AI agents for web, SMS, and voice channels using Golang. Developed scalable Python/Django backend with PSQL for scheduling automation and API/CRM integration. Supported React frontends and deployed with various AWS services.
positions.insights: Skills: Redis · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Go (Programming Language) · NATS · Git · Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Helped build data processing pipelines using Python, Java, C++, NATS, ZeroMQ, and Zookeeper for microservice setups, ensuring smooth data flow to frontend apps. Contributed to reusable React.js/TypeScript frontends for real-time data display. Assisted in deploying scalable microservices with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm charts for easy, flexible deployments.
positions.insights: Skills: Redis · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · C++ · React.js · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Linux · Helm (Software) · Java · NATS · Git · Docker · Kubernetes

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a web app with React.js, Node.js, Express, and MariaDB to import and display static analysis output, making it easier for teams to spot and fix vulnerabilities. Deployed the app on a VM using Apache HTTP Server. Assisted with penetration testing of web and cloud apps using OWASP ZAP for dynamic analysis.

positions.title: Course Development and Teaching Assistant for Data Structures
positions.description: Categorized existing problems based on data structures and developed new data structure problems for future classes to use, ensuring engaging and relevant content for students.

projects.title: Web Application in Python (Django Restframework) and JavaScript (React.js)
projects.description: - Developed a peer evaluation software to replace the Comprehensive Assessment of Team Evaluation Effectiveness (CATME) software that Mines currently uses
